foods.name: Berries
foods.hint: Ripe bushes regrow. Juicy enough to matter when water is far.

foods.name: Acorn
foods.hint: Falls from oak leaves. Bitter raw, but it is starch.

foods.name: Grubs
foods.hint: Found under bark. The only protein before the hunting spear.

foods.name: Bird Egg
foods.hint: Rare find in the canopy. Worth the climb.

foods.name: Brown Mushroom
foods.hint: Safe. Grows in shade and on cave floors.

foods.name: Red Mushroom
foods.hint: Poisonous. The world teaches this one the hard way.

quests.title: First Soil
quests.desc: Dig 4 dirt blocks. LMB breaks a block; in survival it drops into your inventory.

quests.title: Lumberjack
quests.desc: Fell a tree: gather 8 oak logs.

quests.title: Stonecutter
quests.desc: Mine 16 blocks of bedrock stone. Which rock you find depends on the geological province you stand in - dig a cliff and see.

quests.title: Reading the Land
quests.desc: Pick up 3 surface pebbles. A pebble is the rock beneath your feet - the land tells you what it is made of.

quests.title: Forager
quests.desc: Gather 3 plant fibres from tall grass. Everything later starts with cordage.

quests.title: First Meal
quests.desc: Eat something. Right-click food in hand. Berries grow on bushes in forests, acorns fall from oak leaves.

quests.title: To the River
quests.desc: Find a river. The command 'locate biome River' points the way.

quests.title: Reeds
quests.desc: Gather 4 reeds on a riverbank - useful for baskets.

quests.title: Balanced Diet
quests.desc: Hold three different nutrient groups at once: a fruit, a grain and a protein. Living on one group caps how far your health can recover.

quests.title: Coal Trace
quests.desc: Find a coal pebble - a coal seam sleeps below it.

quests.title: Sharp Edge
quests.desc: Find flint. Chert and shale weather into it. Two flint stones struck together will one day give you a blade.

quests.title: First Fire
quests.desc: Get 4 torches. Never enter a cave without light - the dark below is total.

quests.title: Into the Dark
quests.desc: Descend into caves below y=40. Place torches behind you so you can find the way out.

quests.title: Coal
quests.desc: Mine 8 bituminous coal - fuel for the furnaces to come.

quests.title: Copper Gleam
quests.desc: Mine 4 native copper. It lives in basalt and andesite - find a volcanic province. Copper pebbles on the surface mark it.

quests.title: The Deep
quests.desc: Reach depth y=20. Rock is harder here, ores are richer.

quests.title: Signs of Iron
quests.desc: Mine 4 hematite. Shale, chert and schist carry it; a sedimentary basin is the safest bet.

quests.title: The Heights
quests.desc: Climb into a mountain biome.

quests.title: Above the Clouds
quests.desc: Reach altitude y=130.

quests.title: Seed of Forests
quests.desc: Obtain an oak sapling. Oaks drop acorns that grow into young trees.

quests.title: Gold!
quests.desc: Mine native gold. It rides quartz veins through schist and gneiss - a fold belt, below y=46.

quests.title: Polar Explorer
quests.desc: Reach the snowy tundra. Walk straight north or south - climate follows latitude.

quests.title: Pieces of Copper
quests.desc: Gather 12 copper nuggets by breaking copper pebbles on the ground. Copper is too soft to forge - it can only be melted and cast. Every tool of Era II starts as a pile of these.

quests.title: Wet Clay
quests.desc: Dig 8 clay lumps from a riverbank. Clay is the other half of Era II: without a crucible there is nothing to melt copper in.

quests.title: The Crucible
quests.desc: Shape an unfired crucible: hold clay lumps and right-click (4 lumps). Hold CTRL while right-clicking to shape a pickaxe mould instead (3 lumps). Wet clay still has to be pit-fired.

quests.title: Kimberlite
quests.desc: Mine kimberlite below y=22. It exists only under a shield province - the oldest crust there is. Diamond pebbles on the surface are the only clue. The finale of the Stone Age.
